title: Balochistan Seakers and Deputy Speakers Salaries Allowances and Privileges Amendment Act 2003

sections.shortTitle: Balochistan Seakers and Deputy Speakers Salaries Allowances and Privileges Amendment Act 2003
sections.description:
Short title and commencement

ACT II OF 2003
ACT II OF 2003
BALOCHISTAN
SPEAKER'S AND DEPUTY SPEAKER'S
(SALARIES,
ALLOWANCES AND PRIVILEGES) (AMENDMENT) ACT, 2003
An Act further to
amend the Balochistan Speaker's and Deputy Speaker's (Salaries, Allowance and
Privileges) Act, 1975
[Gazette of Balochistan,
Extraordinary, 26th February, 2003]
No.PAB/Legis: V(2)2003, dated
26-2-2003. The Balochistan Speaker's and Deputy Speaker's (Salaries,
Allowances and Privileges) (Amendment) Bill, 2003 having been passed by .the
Provincial Assembly of Balochistan on 25th February, 2003 and assented to by
the Governor of Balochistan, is hereby published as an Act of the Provincial
Assembly:--
It is hereby enacted as
follows:--
1. Short title and
commencement:---(1) This Act may be called the Balochistan Speaker's and
Deputy Speaker's (Salaries, Allowances and Privileges (Amendment) Act, 2003.
(2) It shall come into force at
once.

Privileges) Act, 1975
[Gazette of Balochistan,
Extraordinary, 26th February, 2003]
No.PAB/Legis: V(2)2003, dated
26-2-2003. The Balochistan Speaker's and Deputy Speaker's (Salaries,
Allowances and Privileges) (Amendment) Bill, 2003 having been passed by .the

It is hereby enacted as

4. Insertion of New section
6-B in Act V of 1975.---In the said Act, after section 6-A, the following
new section shall be inserted, namely:-
6-B Utility Allowance.--The
Speaker and Deputy Speaker shall be entitled to receive Utility Allowance at
the rate of rupees "fifteen thousand and twelve thousand"
respectively per month.
